regions.summary: RestorePausePaletteVideoAndUnwind: Decode the valid saved stream with carry clear, optionally restore stage state, then pop the saved palette. Select bank6, update the audio latch and fade back in. Pop the saved video mode and discard the original caller's two-byte return frame before jumping to CPU $C700. Together with the palette pop these four PLA intentionally restore state and unwind, not an ordinary RTS.
